We must have $y=0$ at the $x$-intercepts.  

So, we need to substitute $y=0$ into the equation of the circle and solve the resulting equation for $x,$ if possible:

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{2}+{y}^{2}+8x-6y+21 & =0 \\ {x}^{2}+{0}^{2}+8x-6\cdot 0+21 & =0 \\ {x}^{2}+8x+21 & =0\end{aligned}
$$

We can solve this equation by completing the square, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{x}^{2}+8x+16+21 & =0+16 \\ (x+4)^{2}+21 & =16 \\ (x+4)^{2} & =-5\end{aligned}
$$

Since $(x+4)^{2}\ge 0$ for all values of $x,$ there is no $x$ such that $(x+4)^{2}=-5.$ Therefore, circle has no $x$-intercepts, as shown below.
